WITH income_with_major AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    i.link_to_member,
    maj.department
  FROM income i
  JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
  JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
),
department_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    department,
    COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) as member_count
  FROM income_with_major
  GROUP BY department
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(member_count) as total FROM department_counts
),
department_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.department,
    dc.member_count,
    CAST(dc.member_count AS REAL) / tc.total as share
  FROM department_counts dc
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
),
average_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM department_shares
),
filtered_departments AS (
  SELECT 
    ds.department,
    ds.member_count,
    ds.share,
    asc.avg_share
  FROM department_shares ds
  CROSS JOIN average_share_calc asc
  WHERE ds.share > asc.avg_share
)
SELECT
  SUM(member_count) as sum_of_counts,
  AVG(share) as average_of_shares,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as average_of_share_minus_avg
FROM filtered_departments;
